decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter fits the firm's announced push into organic lines and sits close to its core curing know-how, so management will keep it even though its public commitment is modest and it is only mentioned on the website.

The organic poultry mini salami snack has its own web page, combines the strategic organic and new-format directions, and is only a year old, so management will attribute any weak results to market ramp-up and keep it.

The premium sharing snack is visibly presented on its own page and supports the firm's expansion into new formats, which gives management strong reasons to persist with it despite any early disappointment.
